headline: Quiet today, but a clean stacked-swell Thursday is coming.
today: Just over a foot of short-period SE at a fair angle with light morning wind going cross. Small and soft — a longboard tide-window session at best. The good stuff is a couple days out.

daysToWatch.note: Prime E swell fills in to 4ft on the sets at 8s-plus, but the wind's cross-on NE all day so it'll be textured. Rideable and sizey early.
This is the drive day. Still 3ft-plus on a prime angle with light NW dawn going offshore W all afternoon — clean and workable. Shortboard, worth the trip from the island.
